notes: This verse opens without a waw and the ASV writes no connective.

עצרת → a solemn assembly heads on assembly under rule 31's tie-break, since the ASV writes assembly alone for words of that class; heading on solemn was the competing reading and is named in the unit note.
היה takes the have of the possessive recasting and its ל is unrepresented (rules 43, 40).
